issue_request: FHIR-30766 was a Published/Persuasive Structured Documents issue for R5 requesting the CDA comparison text say Bundle.identifier, not Bundle.id, is equivalent to ClinicalDocument.id.

Commit ad98b08fee0ad580d40e0647f1f87858b231629b later edited the same sentence for code formatting and Bundle.meta.security to ClinicalDocument.confidentialityCode, but introduced the duplicated phrase "where the where the".
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Composition as an active resource, so source/composition/composition-introduction.xml is in build scope. Structured Documents minutes from May 2021 and the implementers Zulip discussion both support mapping CDA ClinicalDocument.id to Bundle.identifier rather than Bundle.id. FHIR-32532 is related background from the same Composition.identifier discussion, but its Jira comments explicitly say the Bundle.identifier mapping proceeded under FHIR-30766.
reconciliation: Removed the duplicated "where the" from source/composition/composition-introduction.xml while preserving the applied Bundle.identifier, ClinicalDocument.id, Bundle.meta.security, and ClinicalDocument.confidentialityCode mappings.
